g.title: JUMP
g.text: Impulse and double jump. Cooldown 0.1 s

g.title: MOVE
g.text: Ground and air movement. Sets velocity

g.title: CAM
g.text: Pitch clamped -80 to 80. Yaw used by Movement

g.title: GC
g.text: Ground cast per FixedUpdate. Coyote 0.15 s

g.title: RUNMOD
g.text: MoveSpeed modifier while run is held
